hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM -- '*.dart'); if [ -n "$staged" ]; then if command -v fvm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$staged" | xargs fvm dart format; else echo "$staged" | xargs dart format; fi; echo "$staged" | xargs git add; fi
